component.name: QuestLHSync Installer
component.summary: Install QuestLHSync on the Steam Frame

description.p: Installs the Steam Frame side of QuestLHSync from its latest GitHub release, or from a release file: lhsyncd as a systemd user service, and the questlhsync_frame driver registered with the headset's SteamVR. It runs the release's own install.sh, and can uninstall again.
